prompts.shallow:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless square game floor albedo texture for a dark first-person grid dungeon crawler, native target 128x128.
Primary request: shallow ankle-deep cold cave water over submerged rough grey-brown limestone grit and worn irregular stone paving. Readable stone fragments just beneath still translucent water, sparse broad ripples and subdued mineral silt in crevices.
Style: restrained hand-painted pixel art, coarse crisp clusters and a small desaturated charcoal/grey/olive palette, matching the supplied existing cave floor reference as the underlying geology. The reference is a style/material input, not an edit target. Dark gritty abandoned waterworks, believable and quiet.
Composition: top-down orthographic square filling the entire canvas, uniform material scale, seamlessly tileable on all four edges. NO viewpoint, horizon, shoreline, room, border, large focal object or vignette.
Lighting: neutral diffuse local material values; NO torch reflections, beams, bright sparkles, cast shadows, glowing blue water, caustic light lattice or baked directional lighting. Submerged stone remains readable. Ripples broad and restrained, not ocean waves.
Constraints: one opaque square texture, no text, labels, objects, vegetation, skulls, coins or people.
prompts.deep:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless square deep-water surface albedo for a dark first-person pixel-art dungeon crawler, native target128.
Primary request: opaque black-green water in an underground flooded stone channel. No visible bottom. Sparse broad low-amplitude overlapping ripple arcs, very subdued silver-grey ridges and a few silt streaks. The water should feel deep, stagnant and threatening, while still visibly liquid at phone size.
Style: restrained hand-painted pixel art with coarse crisp clusters and approximately24 dark desaturated charcoal/green-grey colours. Broad low contrast forms; no photographic fine noise.
Composition: strict top-down orthographic view, square material covering the full canvas, seamlessly tileable on all four sides. Consistent scale, no shoreline or contained pool boundary.
Lighting: diffuse material values only, no directional illumination or scenery reflections. The brightest ripple ridges remain muted, not white. No blue glow, glitter, caustic lattice, foam, ocean swell or magical particles.
Constraints: opaque texture only, no transparency, text, frame, borders, vignette, objects, creatures, visible floor, perspective or horizon.
prompts.sluice-closed:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent front-facing game room prop, a CLOSED sluice wheel and gate for a dark pixel-art dungeon crawler; native target192 square.
Primary request: a huge corroded iron handwheel, taller than a person, mounted to the LEFT upright of a low squat stone sluice arch. A thick threaded spindle and simple gearing connect it to a CLOSED vertical iron gate in the arch. The gate is fully lowered, holding black water behind it; narrow side gaps suggest water pressure without a painted pool in front. Six broad heavy spokes, unmistakable circular wheel silhouette. Old engineered water-control machinery, not a doorway with a small decorative valve.
Materials: rough dark grey-brown limestone blocks, rusted black iron, damp mineral streaks, a little green-brown silt at the footing. No wood, chains across the opening, fire or modern industrial paint. The provided lower water-gate sprite is a MATERIAL/STYLE REFERENCE ONLY; do not copy its tall barred dungeon-door design.
Composition: complete single architectural assembly, straight front orthographic view, whole wheel/stone surround/base visible with generous transparent margins. Square canvas, base on one level near88% height; top near10%. Wheel and gate of comparable visual weight, a legible mechanical prop at phone size. No surrounding wall or scene.
Style: restrained dark-fantasy hand-painted pixel art, broad readable clusters, fine dark contours, no photorealistic detail, about48 colours. Neutral local form shading, no torch glow or dramatic cast shadows.
Constraints: true transparent background, no ground rectangle, painted scenery, text, labels, people, symbols or frame. This is the reference state for a registered OPEN version: keep the assembly clear and reusable.
prompts.sluice-open:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: registered OPEN/resolved state of the supplied sluice prop for a dark pixel-art dungeon crawler.
Edit target: the supplied transparent closed sluice-wheel assembly. Preserve its exact canvas size, framing, position, scale, camera angle, wheel silhouette, stone surround, rust colours, gears, base and every outside edge as closely as possible.
Change ONLY the gate state: the heavy iron panel is now fully raised into a concealed slot behind the lintel. Show a clearly open dark rectangular water-channel aperture beneath it, with the gate's bottom edge just under the header. The machinery and enormous side handwheel remain intact. Give the wheel spokes a small credible turn without moving the hub or outer rim.
The open aperture must be OPAQUE very dark charcoal, with only a faint receding stone-channel suggestion; do NOT make the passage transparent like the outside background. The foreground stone trough is now drained, showing damp worn stone and a narrow dark silt streak, no full pool or waterfall. At native192 this must clearly read opened/drained beside the lowered gate.
Keep pixel-art technique, palette and neutral local material shading. No new scenery, dramatic illumination, glow, captions, symbols, people, added objects, cropping or rescaling. Keep genuinely transparent alpha OUTSIDE the assembly.
